description: This bar chart, from the paper "SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware Reinforcement Learning," compares the performance scores of three large language models—SRPO-7B (dark blue), GRPO-7B (medium blue), and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B (light blue)—across four distinct evaluation benchmarks: MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics. The vertical y-axis represents the "Score," scaled linearly from 35 to 80 with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 5. The horizontal x-axis lists the four benchmarks in the order presented. For each benchmark, three bars are grouped side-by-side, with the SRPO-7B model consistently achieving the highest score, followed by GRPO-7B, and then Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. Specifically, in MathVista, the scores are 75.8 for SRPO-7B, 72.3 for GRPO-7B, and 68.2 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B; in MathVerse, they are 55.8, 52.9, and 46.3; in MMMU-Pro, they are 42.3, 39.9, and 36.9; and in Physics, they are 60.6, 53.5, and 45.4. The bars are not sorted by value, and no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding is applied to any specific bar.
